contentItem.title: 三角形的两边不能在同侧形成两个顶点
contentItem.englishTitle: Given two straight lines constructed on a straight line (from its extremities) and meeting in a point, there cannot be constructed on the same straight line (from its extremities), and on the same side of it, two other straight lines meeting in another point and equal to the former two respectively, namely each to that which has the same extremity with it.

surfaces.text: Given two straight lines constructed on a straight line (from its extremities) and meeting in a point, there cannot be constructed on the same straight line (from its extremities), and on the same side of it, two other straight lines meeting in another point and equal to the former two respectively, namely each to that which has the same extremity with it.
鉴于两条直线(从极端)建起,在一个点上相交,因此无法在同一直线(从极端)上建起,在同一侧,另外两条直线在另一点上相交,分别等于前两条,即每一条直线与直线的高度相同。
一线为底出两腰线，其相遇止有一点，不得别有腰线与元腰线等、而于此点外相遇。
在同一条底边的同一侧，从底边两个端点分别引出两条线段，并使它们相交于一点。不可能再从同样的两个端点引出另外两条分别与原线段等长的线段，却让它们相交于另一个不同的点。

For, if possible, given two straight lines AC, CB constructed on the straight line AB and meeting at the point C, let two other straight lines AD, DB be constructed on the same straight line AB, on the same side of it, meeting in another point D and equal to the former two respectively, namely each to that which has the same extremity with it, so that CA is equal to DA which has the same extremity A with it, and CB to DB which has the same extremity B with it; and let CD be joined.
如果可能,则在AB线上建造的两条直线AC、CB和C点相交,在AB线同一侧的同一直线AD、DB线上建造的另外两条直线AB、DB线,在另一端相交,与前两条相同,即每一条与前两条的高度相同,因此,CA等于DA,与前一条的高度A,CB至DB等于B,与前一条的高度相同。CD连接

Then, since AC is equal to AD, the angle ACD is also equal to the angle ADC; [[I. 5](/principles/euclid-1-5)] therefore the angle ADC is greater than the angle DCB; therefore the angle CDB is much greater than the angle DCB.
AC等于AD,ACD角度也等于ADC角度;因此,ADC角度大于DCB角度;因此,CDB角度大大高于DCB角度。 [[I. 5](/principles/euclid-1-5)]
Again, since CB is equal to DB, the angle CDB is also equal to the angle DCB. But it was also proved much greater than it: which is impossible.
同样,由于CB等于DB,CDB角度也等于DCB角度,但事实证明它也比DCB角度更大:这是不可能的。

blocks.title: 徐光启、利玛窦历史中译 1

surfaces.text: 一线为底出两腰线，其相遇止有一点，不得别有腰线与元腰线等、而于此点外相遇。
在同一条底边的同一侧，从底边两个端点分别引出两条线段，并使它们相交于一点。不可能再从同样的两个端点引出另外两条分别与原线段等长的线段，却让它们相交于另一个不同的点。

blocks.title: 徐光启、利玛窦历史中译 2

surfaces.text: 若言丁在丙外又有三说，俱不可通。何者？
如果你说 丁 存在于 丙 之外，还有三种其他理论，所有这些都无法理解。这是为什么呢？
